For more information, visit: www.smartbuyglasses.com . Position Overview: Digital Marketing Trainee Are you ready to fast-track your digital marketing career? Our accelerated Digital Marketing Trainee Program is designed to turn ambitious individuals into versatile marketing professionals. Over six months, you'll immerse yourself in hands-on training, gaining expertise across key areas like copywriting, content creation, SEO, social media, and more. You'll learn from industry leaders and contribute directly to real-world projects that drive results. This program is perfect for someone passionate about e-commerce, content creation, and all things digital. If you're eager to dive deep into fashion and eyewear while building expertise across marketing disciplines, this role is for you! Key Responsibilities: Research and craft high-impact content for websites, press releases, social media, and other marketing channels. Work alongside talented designers and photographers to develop integrated, eye-catching content. Gain in-depth knowledge of top eyewear brands and industry trends, staying on top of new releases. Ensure brand consistency and strong digital presence across all communication channels. Collaborate on cutting-edge digital marketing strategies and execution plans. Qualifications: Native-level English fluency with flawless grammar and writing skills. A passion for writing, blogging, and digital marketing. Basic Photoshop skills (a plus). Strong interest in design trends, marketing, technology, and social media. Skills
